name: securityFilterChain
parameters:
(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler)
signature:
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler) throws Exception
body:
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/v1/bakeries/onboarding")
                        .access(userRole("CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries/onboarding",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/onboarding/complete")
                        .access(userRole("CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html")
                        .permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/v1/bakeries", "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}",
                                "/api/v1/products", "/api/v1/products/{productId}").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}")
                        .access(serviceScope("bakery:profile:read"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PUT, "/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/onboarding/activate")
                        .access(serviceScope("bakery:onboarding:activate"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/internal/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/members/{userId}/authorization",
                                "/internal/v1/users/{userId}/bakery-memberships")
                        .access(serviceScope("bakery:membership:read"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/internal/v1/catalog/quotes",
                                "/internal/v1/catalog/customization-quotes",
                                "/internal/v1/catalog/add-on-quotes")
                        .access(serviceScope("bakery:catalog:quote"))
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").access(userRole("ADMIN"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries").access(userRole("BAKERY_OWNER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/submit-for-approval")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/logo",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/cover")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/add-ons/{addOnId}/image")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/images")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/publish",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/hide",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/archive")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/members")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/categories",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/add-ons",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PATCH,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/categories/{categoryId}",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/add-ons/{addOnId}",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/categories",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/add-ons",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PUT,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/operations",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/options")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.DELETE,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/categories/{categoryId}",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/add-ons/{addOnId}")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.DELETE,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/products/{productId}/images/{imageId}")
                        .access(bakeryOwner())
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }

name: jwtAuthenticationConverter
securityFilterChain
parameters:
(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler
    )
signature:
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler
    ) throws Exception
body:
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/v3/api-docs.yaml",
                                "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/conversations")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/conversations/*/close")
                        .access(userRoleAny("ROLE_CUSTOMER", "ROLE_BAKERY_OWNER"))
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").access(userToken())
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }

@Query("""
            select count(m) from ChatMessage m
            where m.conversationId = :conversationId
              and m.senderParticipantId <> :participantId
              and m.createdAt >= :joinedAt
              and not exists (
                  select r.id from MessageReceipt r
                  where r.id.messageId = m.id
                    and r.id.participantId = :participantId
                    and r.readAt is not null
              )
            """)

name: markReadThrough
annotations:
@Query(value = """
            insert into message_receipts (message_id, participant_id, delivered_at, read_at)
            select m.id, :participantId, current_timestamp, current_timestamp
            from messages m
            where m.conversation_id = :conversationId
              and m.sender_participant_id <> :participantId
              and (m.created_at < :throughCreatedAt
                   or (m.created_at = :throughCreatedAt and m.id <= :throughMessageId))
            on conflict (message_id, participant_id) do update
            set delivered_at = coalesce(message_receipts.delivered_at, excluded.delivered_at),
                read_at = greatest(message_receipts.read_at, excluded.read_at)
            """, nativeQuery = true)

name: securityFilterChain
parameters:
(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler,
            CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource)
signature:
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler,
            CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource)
            throws Exception
body:
{
        http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource))
                .sessionManagement(
                        session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(
                        authorize ->
                                authorize
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.POST, "/internal/v1/auth/service-token")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers("/actuator/health", "/actuator/health/**")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.GET,
                                                "/.well-known/jwks.json",
                                                "/v3/api-docs/**",
                                                "/v3/api-docs.yaml",
                                                "/swagger-ui/**",
                                                "/swagger-ui.html")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.POST,
                                                "/api/v1/auth/register",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/login",
                                                "/api/v1/auth/refresh")
                                        .permitAll()
                                        .requestMatchers(
                                                HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/users/*/addresses/*")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:address:read"))
                                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/users/*")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:user:read"))
                                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PUT, "/internal/v1/users/*/bakery-owner")
                                        .access(serviceScope("identity:bakery-owner:grant"))
                                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**")
                                        .denyAll()
                                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**")
                                        .access(userRole("ROLE_ADMIN"))
                                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**")
                                        .access(tokenType("user"))
                                        .anyRequest()
                                        .denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(
                        resourceServer ->
                                resourceServer
                                        .jwt(
                                                jwt ->
                                                        jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(
                                                                jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(
                        exceptions ->
                                exceptions
                                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }

name: detail
body:
{
        Actor actor = Actor.current();
        boolean allOffers = actor.admin() || request.getCustomerId().equals(actor.id());
        Set<UUID> ids =
                allOffers
                        ? Set.of()
                        : bakery.memberships(actor.id()).stream()
                                .map(m -> m.bakeryId())
                                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toSet());
        var summaries =
                (allOffers
                                ? offers.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                        request.getId())
                                : offers.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdAndBakeryIdInOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                                        request.getId(), ids))
                        .stream()
                                .map(
                                        o ->
                                                new CakeRequestResponse.OfferSummary(
                                                        o.getId(),
                                                        o.getBakeryId(),
                                                        o.getStatus(),
                                                        o.getTotalPrice(),
                                                        o.getExpiresAt()))
                                .toList();
        var imageResponses =
                images.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(request.getId()).stream()
                        .map(this::image)
                        .toList();
        return mapper.detail(
                request,
                preferences.findById(request.getId()).orElse(null),
                options.findByCakeRequestIdOrderByIdAsc(request.getId()),
                imageResponses,
                history.findTop100ByCakeRequestIdOrderByChangedAtDesc(request.getId()),
                summaries);
    }

                && bytes[4] == 13
                && bytes[5] == 10
                && bytes[6] == 26

        if (bytes.length >= 3
                && bytes[0] == (byte) 255
                && bytes[1] == (byte) 216
                && bytes[2] == (byte) 255) return "image/jpeg";
        if (bytes.length >= 12
                && new String(bytes, 0, 4, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
                        .equals("RIFF")
                && new String(bytes, 8, 4, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
                        .equals("WEBP")) return "image/webp";
        throw new BusinessException(400, "Unsupported image content");
    }

signature:
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            Converter<Jwt, ? extends AbstractAuthenticationToken> jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler
    ) throws Exception
body:
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/v3/api-docs.yaml",
                                "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/internal/v1/orders/from-offer")
                        .access(serviceScope("order:create-from-offer"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/internal/v1/orders/*/context")
                        .access(serviceScope("order:context:read"))
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PATCH, "/api/v1/admin/reviews/**")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_ADMIN"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/v1/orders/direct",
                                "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.PATCH, "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.DELETE, "/api/v1/orders/*/review")
                        .access(userRole("ROLE_CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/**").access(userToken())
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }

name: securityFilterChain
parameters:
(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler)
signature:
@Bean
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter,
            AuthenticationEntryPoint authenticationEntryPoint,
            AccessDeniedHandler accessDeniedHandler) throws Exception
body:
{
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(authorize -> authorize
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/v3/api-docs/**", "/swagger-ui/**", "/swagger-ui.html")
                        .permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/internal/v1/subscriptions/bakeries/{bakeryId}/entitlement")
                        .access(serviceScope("subscription:entitlement:read"))
                        .requestMatchers("/internal/v1/**").denyAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/api/v1/subscription-plans",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-plans/{planId}")
                        .permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers("/api/v1/admin/**").access(userRole("ADMIN"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription-orders",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-orders/{orderId}/payments")
                        .access(userRole("BAKERY_OWNER", "CUSTOMER"))
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET,
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription",
                                "/api/v1/bakeries/{bakeryId}/subscription-orders",
                                "/api/v1/subscription-orders/{orderId}")
                        .access(userRole("BAKERY_OWNER", "CUSTOMER", "ADMIN"))
                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
                .oauth2ResourceServer(resourceServer -> resourceServer
                        .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter))
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler))
                .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(authenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(accessDeniedHandler));
        return http.build();
    }
